summary: Way easier to share one lyric per Grateful Dead Song while working than it is Operation Ivy. Twenty Minute songs versus two minute songs. Think its time for some Miles Davis, have mad work to do today. Mr. Davis holds my hand and points the way.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Way easier to share one lyric per Grateful Dead Song while working than it is Operation Ivy. Twenty Minute songs versus two minute songs. Think its time for some Miles Davis, have mad work to do today. Mr. Davis holds my hand and points the way.
